=== a-row-of-buffet
VLA	(if (= B11 1) (+ Day.last!$B$3 $B$6) Hustle.last!B13)
TEXT	=IF(B11=1,Day.last!$B$3+$B$6,Hustle.last!B13)
=== the-input-card-s-tally
VLA	(+ Tally.last!B1 (if (and (= Input!B1 1) (= Input.last!B1 0)) 1 0))
TEXT	=Tally.last!B1+IF(AND(Input!B1=1,Input.last!B1=0),1,0)
=== buffet-s-clock-text
VLA	(& (int (/ B15 60)) ":" (if (= (mod B15 60) 0) "00" "30"))
TEXT	=INT(B15/60)&":"&IF(MOD(B15,60)=0,"00","30")
=== sand-s-brush
VLA	(if (if (< Gate!$B2 0) false (<= (^ (- (column) Gate!$A2) 2) Gate!$B2)) Gate!$C2 0)
TEXT	=IF(IF(Gate!$B2<0,FALSE,(COLUMN()-Gate!$A2)^2<=Gate!$B2),Gate!$C2,0)
=== kairos-s-words-a-semicolon-in-a-text
VLA	(if (= State!B1 3) (& "Level " State!B3 " stacked: Z goes on; X takes the minor.") "")
TEXT	=IF(State!B1=3,"Level "&State!B3&" stacked: Z goes on; X takes the minor.","")
=== buffet-s-dollars
VLA	(& (if (< Stocks!E5 1000) "  " "") (int (/ Stocks!E5 100)) "." (if (< (mod Stocks!E5 100) 10) "0" "") (mod Stocks!E5 100))
TEXT	=IF(Stocks!E5<1000,"  ","")&INT(Stocks!E5/100)&"."&IF(MOD(Stocks!E5,100)<10,"0","")&MOD(Stocks!E5,100)

=== every-error
VLA	(choose 1 (error "#NULL!") (error "#DIV/0!") (error "#VALUE!") (error "#REF!") (error "#NAME?") (error "#NUM!") (error "#N/A"))
TEXT	=CHOOSE(1,#NULL!,#DIV/0!,#VALUE!,#REF!,#NAME?,#NUM!,#N/A)

=== malformed-empty
